dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: That pan isn't on yet, the fish is raw.

dialogue.text: My mistake, you're right. Turn on the fryer or pan when you're ready.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Give me a shout when that potato finishes cooking.

dialogue.text: Is anything on the heat already done and just sitting there?

dialogue.text: The serving pass accepts an exact match only. Extra ingredients like lettuce will fail the order.

dialogue.text: Customer asked for it, we're adding lettuce.

dialogue.text: The fryer is smoking! Clear your plate at the trash and scoop the potatoes out before they burn.

dialogue.text: The pan is smoking, not the fryer.

dialogue.text: The fryer on the counter is smoking too. Clear the plate at the trash now.

dialogue.text: Neither fryer is smoking, I'm handling the plate.

dialogue.text: Do not scoop raw fish onto the plate. Scoop the cooked fish from the pan at the top counter.

dialogue.speaker: user

dialogue.text: Do not serve yet! The order requires two cooked potatoes, but you only have one on the plate.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: I'm grabbing the second potato right now.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Put the plate down on an empty counter first so your hands are free to chop and cook the second potato.

dialogue.text: Second potato is already cooked in the fryer.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: The fryer is empty. You need to chop a raw potato and cook it first.

dialogue.text: Both fryers are empty, cooking another potato.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: Put your plate down on an empty counter so your hands are free.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: Putting the plate down now.

dialogue.text: That's the fish crate. Go to the potato crate at the top right to get a potato.

dialogue.text: I'm heading to the potato crate right now.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.text: That fryer needs chopped potato. You must chop the potato at a cutting board first before frying it.

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.text: I chopped it first, it's already cooking.

dialogue.text: Do not add lettuce to the plate! The order must be exactly fish, potato, potato or it will be rejected.

dialogue.text: I told you, lettuce is going on it.

dialogue.text: You added lettuce to the plate. The pass strictly rejects anything extra. Go to the trash to clear the plate.
